title: Salt Tax
html:
This quest is not fully written yet. Steps, items or dialogue may be missing.Varra Sunstrike's marauders took Agauton's salt tax off Wilson Barthrone's cart, and her buyers come for it within the hour.

About

Given bySergeant Idony Marsh
Level30
LengthLong
KindSide
Quest points1

What you need

  • Salt Tax Chest ×1

Steps

  1. Talk to Sergeant Idony Marsh to get the quest.
  2. Kill 14 Dune Marauders (14)
  3. Kill Varra Sunstrike at 1096, 516
    Bring Wilson Barthrone the salt tax chest - Salt Tax Chest at 1141, 192

Rewards

Reward
Gold4,800
Character XP150,000
Quest points1
Choose oneBloomguard Arms
or Bloomleather Arms
or Bloomweave Arms

What Sergeant Idony Marsh says

Wilson Barthrone: That's the chest! Still locked, too. She never got it open.

Wilson Barthrone: I'd have gone after it myself, but I dig for a living. I don't fight.

Wilson Barthrone: Sergeant Marsh left some Bloomguard gauntlets with me in case you made it back in time. Take whichever pair you like.

Handing it in

"Sergeant Marsh left some Bloomguard gauntlets with me in case you made it back in time. Take whichever pair you like."
